subject: CS478
filterSummary: Selected 5 English videos and 1 Arabic video. English coverage is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is very sparse; only one eligible video was found for one topic. For other Arabic topics, all candidates failed relevance or language gates.

coverage.note: No candidates found for computer graphics radiometry. All shortlisted videos were for unrelated topics like statistics or GIS and failed the relevance gate.
All candidates teach the general mathematical Law of Cosines for trigonometry, not its specific application in computer graphics for diffuse lighting, failing the relevance gate.
No Arabic-language candidates found. All potential matches were in other languages and failed the language gate.
No candidates found for computer graphics lighting. All shortlisted videos were for other fields like physics or electrical engineering and failed the relevance gate.

videos.title: TU Wien Rendering #2 - Radiometry Recap, Light Attenuation
videos.filter_reason: Excellent, concise recap of radiometry concepts for rendering from a highly-regarded channel, with great visuals and high viewership.

videos.title: Ambient, Diffuse, and Specular Shading | 3D Graphics Overview
videos.filter_reason: Perfectly framed for developers, this video explains Lambertian surfaces and explicitly connects the cosine law to the dot product calculation.

videos.title: OpenGL - lighting with the Phong reflection model (part 1 of 2)
videos.filter_reason: A practical OpenGL coding tutorial that builds the Phong model from scratch, directly addressing the implementation challenges students face.

videos.title: FLAT SHADING, GOURAUD SHADING & PHONG SHADING
videos.filter_reason: A very popular and clear comparison of the three main shading techniques, perfectly matching the topic and explaining the core differences.

videos.title: Computer Graphics Light Attenuation
videos.filter_reason: This video focuses specifically on the concept and formula for light attenuation in computer graphics, the most difficult part of this topic.

videos.title: 6- Lighting Video
videos.filter_reason: This is a comprehensive lecture on lighting in computer graphics which covers the fundamental models, and was the only eligible candidate.
